d: Salman Khan is back behind the microphone for "Teri Sexy Beauty" from Maatrubhumi, but the song has sparked a wave of trolling! Is this a catchy new track or has Salman Khan's singing become the biggest talking point? In this episode of Samosa Critics, we (Abhishek Manchanda, Prashant Kapoor) react to the Maatrubhumi song "Teri Sexy Beauty", discuss Salman Khan's singing, the music, visuals and lyrics, and decode why the track is facing such strong reactions online. Is the song actually entertaining, or has it missed the mark? Watch our reaction and join the debate in the comments! Teri…
